name: almanac-server
description: Almanac sync server — stores opaque ciphertext and nothing else. A breach yields noise.

scripts.db:init: wrangler d1 execute almanac --remote --file=schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute almanac --remote --file=../../../packages/server/schema.sharing.sql && wrangler d1 execute almanac --remote --file=../../../packages/server/schema.recovery.sql
scripts.db:init:local: wrangler d1 execute almanac --local --file=schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute almanac --local --file=../../../packages/server/schema.sharing.sql && wrangler d1 execute almanac --local --file=../../../packages/server/schema.recovery.sql
